related.title: DSSE：PAE位元組長度與型別域分離
related.titleEn: DSSE: PAE byte lengths and payload-type separation
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：57.143%與64.286%可重算，跨issuer相同SAN仍拒絕；憑證有效不等於簽署者符合發布政策。 交付fulcio-identities.csv、兩種issuer欄位圖與身分負例；資料皆為公開樣本或合成描述。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Reproduce approximately 57.143 and 64.286 percent and reject equal SAN under the wrong issuer. Certificate validity must remain distinct from release-signer authorization. Deliver fulcio-identities.csv, the two-issuer field map and identity counterexamples. Use public examples or synthetic descriptors and include no reusable private signing material.
related.difference: 以payloadType為text/plain、內容為A量B建立本地位元組樣本；輸出十六進位、位元組長度與完整PAE，對錯用字元數建立負例。
related.differenceEn: Use payloadType text/plain and payload A量B as local byte fixtures. Emit hexadecimal bytes, byte lengths and complete PAE, including a negative control that incorrectly uses character count instead of UTF-8 length.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 本地政策要求SAN與OIDC發行者精確匹配，且先通過鏈與用途檢查；不能把issuer的字串部分比對或顯示名稱當作穩定身分。 14份中10份SAN符合，其中8份也符合OIDC issuer；另外4份SAN不同，皆不納入雙重匹配集合。 雙重匹配率8/14×100≈57.143%；修復一份測試描述的issuer關聯後為9/14×100≈64.286%。
PAE以DSSEv1、兩個十進位長度及空格界定欄位；長度是位元組數，payloadType本身也受簽章保護。keyid僅為提示，不能獨立決定信任。 text/plain為10位元組，A量B為5位元組；PAE前綴6位元組、四個分隔空格4位元組，長度字串分別為2與1位元組。 PAE總長6+4+2+10+1+5=28位元組；內容改A量子B為8位元組時總長31。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: The local policy requires exact SAN and OIDC issuer matches after chain and usage checks. Substring issuer matching and display-name comparison are not stable identity contracts and must not substitute for the selected typed certificate fields. Ten of 14 descriptors match SAN, and eight of those also match OIDC issuer. Four have a different SAN and remain outside the joint set even if they share an otherwise trusted CA or identity provider. Joint matching is 8/14×100, approximately 57.143 percent. Correcting one fixture issuer association gives 9/14×100, approximately 64.286 percent, without adding another trusted identity provider.

PAE separates DSSEv1, decimal lengths and fields with spaces. Lengths count bytes and the payload type is authenticated. A keyid hint does not independently establish trust, so the verifier still selects an authorized key through its own policy. text/plain has ten bytes and A量B has five UTF-8 bytes. Count six bytes for the prefix, four separating spaces and two and one bytes for the decimal length strings respectively; retain the exact payload encoding. Total PAE length is 6+4+2+10+1+5=28 bytes. Replacing the payload with A量子B gives eight payload bytes and total length 31, while the one-digit payload-length field remains one byte.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.

related.title: GitHub Artifact Attestations：檔案摘要與工作流程來源關聯
related.titleEn: GitHub artifact attestations: binding local bytes to workflow provenance
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：57.143%與64.286%可重算，跨issuer相同SAN仍拒絕；憑證有效不等於簽署者符合發布政策。 交付fulcio-identities.csv、兩種issuer欄位圖與身分負例；資料皆為公開樣本或合成描述。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Reproduce approximately 57.143 and 64.286 percent and reject equal SAN under the wrong issuer. Certificate validity must remain distinct from release-signer authorization. Deliver fulcio-identities.csv, the two-issuer field map and identity counterexamples. Use public examples or synthetic descriptors and include no reusable private signing material.
related.difference: 建立15份本地產物及合成證明描述，列SHA-256、來源repo、commit與workflow；將同名不同內容、fork來源及錯workflow列為負例。
related.differenceEn: Build 15 local artifact/provenance descriptors with SHA-256, source repository, commit and workflow. Include equal names with different contents, fork origins and unexpected workflows, keeping repository ownership distinct from mere filename resemblance.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 本地政策要求SAN與OIDC發行者精確匹配，且先通過鏈與用途檢查；不能把issuer的字串部分比對或顯示名稱當作穩定身分。 14份中10份SAN符合，其中8份也符合OIDC issuer；另外4份SAN不同，皆不納入雙重匹配集合。 雙重匹配率8/14×100≈57.143%；修復一份測試描述的issuer關聯後為9/14×100≈64.286%。
本地發布政策要求位元組摘要與subject一致，且來源repo/workflow符合核准契約；公開與私人repo的Sigstore實例及透明度特性不同，不能假設全部都有公開日誌。 15份中12份摘要相符，當中9份repo與workflow也符合；其他列保留哪個來源欄位失敗。 完整通過率9/15×100=60%；補正兩份摘要已符合者的工作流程證據後為11/15×100≈73.333%。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: The local policy requires exact SAN and OIDC issuer matches after chain and usage checks. Substring issuer matching and display-name comparison are not stable identity contracts and must not substitute for the selected typed certificate fields. Ten of 14 descriptors match SAN, and eight of those also match OIDC issuer. Four have a different SAN and remain outside the joint set even if they share an otherwise trusted CA or identity provider. Joint matching is 8/14×100, approximately 57.143 percent. Correcting one fixture issuer association gives 9/14×100, approximately 64.286 percent, without adding another trusted identity provider.

The local release policy requires matching artifact and subject digests plus approved repository/workflow provenance. Public and private repository attestation paths have different Sigstore transparency characteristics, so do not assume every attestation is backed by the public log. Twelve of 15 artifacts match the subject digest, and nine of those also match repository and workflow policy. Preserve the exact failed provenance field for the other rows instead of reporting only a generic invalid signature. Complete acceptance is 9/15×100=60 percent. Correcting workflow evidence for two digest-matching artifacts gives 11/15×100, approximately 73.333 percent, with no change to the trusted repository set.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.
